declined.subject: retrieval
declined.reason: Precondition does not hold: retrieval governs the ingest and query machinery that cuts, indexes, embeds, fuses, and ranks a corpus too large to hand over whole, producing a small relevant slice for a consumer. The pg-evaluation-store context (crates/store-pg/src/scores.rs, score_summary.rs, benchmarks.rs, datasets.rs, dataset_lineage.rs, rubrics.rs, labels.rs, calibrations.rs, prompts.rs) implements PostgreSQL persistence and querying for evaluation artifacts (judge verdicts, dimensional score summaries, benchmark runs, evaluation dataset items with lineage, scoring rubrics, human verdict labels, judge calibration statistics, and prompt versions), containing no retrieval pipeline, document chunking, embedding vectors, lane fusion, or ranking mechanisms. Per instructions, not-applicable is not accepted from this seat, so this context is declined.
